channel.title: Vice Replay: GTA 6 news and guides
channel.description: Vice Replay: GTA 6 news and guides

item.title: GTA 6 Clothing Stores: Where to Buy Clothes (Map)
item.description: Where to buy clothes in GTA 6: the shops in Key Lento you can reach first, how many clothing stores there are (guides count 67) and the five styles they sell.

item.title: GTA 6 ATM Robbery: How to Steal ATMs With a Winch (and the Catch)
item.description: How to rob ATMs in GTA 6: get a winch or a tow truck, pull an outdoor ATM off the wall, open it, lose the cops, and why marked bills need the Dye Pack Jammer.

item.title: GTA 6 Criminal Profile: All Levels and How to Lower It
item.description: How GTA 6's criminal profile works: the four levels from Professional to Psycho, the Shattered state you can't come back from, and how to lower your profile.

item.title: GTA 6 Deals and Discount Codes: What's Real This Week (Checked)
item.description: Every real way to pay less around GTA 6 this week, checked in 2+ sources: GTA 6 itself isn't discounted, PS Plus is up to 33% off, the DualSense is $54, and 'free GTA 6 codes' are scams.

item.title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Every Location So Far (Map)
item.description: Every GTA 6 easter egg location, pinned on Rockstar's official map: the Backrooms, the Silent Hill hotel (safe code 955214), the Ninja Turtles, a ghost ship, the UFO and more. No spoilers.

item.title: Did They Catch the GTA 6 Hacker? Arion Kurtaj's Sentence Explained (Nov 2026)
item.description: Yes: Arion Kurtaj, who hacked Rockstar in 2022, was sentenced to 7 years on Nov 23, 2026 and released on licence the same day. Why, and what the court order means.

item.title: GTA 6 How To: Switch Characters, Key Cloner, Impound and Losing the Cops
item.description: Quick answers to GTA 6's most searched how-to questions: how to switch between Jason and Lucia, get the key cloner, get your car out of the impound and lower your wanted level. Light on spoilers.

item.title: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: The Best Ways, Early to Late Game
item.description: How to make money fast in GTA 6: stolen cars early, jewelry and high-end cars in Chapter 3, bank vaults late, plus the money cheat and how to keep your cash safe. Light on spoilers.

item.title: GTA 6 Map: Official HD Leonida Map, Interactive, With Secret Spots
item.description: Rockstar's official Leonida map in full HD: zoom in to street names, turn pin layers on and off, and find GTA 6's easter eggs, secrets and key places. No spoilers.

item.title: Does GTA 6 Have Online? GTA 6 Online Release Date: What's Confirmed
item.description: Is there a GTA 6 Online? Not yet: Rockstar hasn't announced a multiplayer mode or a date. Where the '2027' talk comes from, and what happens to GTA Online. Checked Nov 24.

item.title: GTA 6 Radio Stations: Every Station and Its Hosts (V-Rock, Flash FM and More)
item.description: GTA 6's radio stations and who hosts them: Lindsey Buckingham on V-Rock, Bad Bunny on Cocoteo FM, Keith Richards on Gloriana Blues and more. From NME, PC Gamer and GameSpot.

item.title: GTA 6 Shoe Store: Where to Buy Shoes (Map)
item.description: The first GTA 6 shoe store is Flip Flop House in Key Lento. How to find every other footwear store with the in-game map filter, and how many there are.

item.title: GTA 6 Streaming Records: Most-Watched Streamers and Every Number
item.description: GTA 6's launch on stream, checked: a 7.91 million peak, 125.47 million hours in 24 hours, and the most-watched creators (IShowSpeed, TheBurntPeanut, alanzoka). No spoilers.

item.title: GTA 6 Trophies: How Hard Is the Platinum? (55 Trophies, 100%)
item.description: GTA 6 has 55 trophies and the Platinum, 'Vice Got a Price!', needs 100% completion: guides say 100 to 200 hours. Who got it first, and what turns trophies off. No story spoilers.

item.title: GTA 6 at The Game Awards 2026: All 8 Nominations, Rivals and Odds
item.description: GTA 6 has 8 nominations at The Game Awards 2026, the most of any game. Every category, every rival, our odds, the record it can't break, and how to watch on Dec 10.

item.title: GTA 6 Update 1.002.002 Patch Notes: All 7 Fixes (Nov 23, 2026)
item.description: Rockstar's notes for GTA 6 update 1.002.002 (Nov 23, 2026): 7 fixes, from crashes and autosaves to phone calls and wanted levels. Download size, earlier updates and sources.

item.title: Does GTA 6 Have Darts? No, and Rockstar Explains Why (Pool Is In)
item.description: GTA 6 has no darts or bowling. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told VGC why: "even we do not" have unlimited time or money. Pool made it in. Sources inside, no spoilers.

item.title: GTA 6 Sales and Records: Every Launch Week Number vs GTA 5 (Checked)
item.description: How much has GTA 6 made? Take-Two's official $3.79B vs GTA 5's $800M, the 99 Metacritic score, the 7.9M streaming peak and the most-watched streams, with sources.

item.title: How Long Is GTA 6? Story Length, Real Finish Times and 100% (No Spoilers)
item.description: How long to beat GTA 6: reviewers took 50-70 hours, Rockstar's own run took about 80, IShowSpeed finished in 52 h 31 min. GTA 5 comparison, 100% estimates, no spoilers.

item.title: Is GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Worth It? The 5 Shops Only It Unlocks (No Spoilers)
item.description: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition is $99.99 vs $79.99 for Standard. Rockstar says five places are only open with it: two mod shops, a salon, a tattoo shop and a clothing store. Full list from Rockstar's page, no spoilers.

item.title: GTA 6 Beginner Tips: 6 Things the Game Doesn't Tell You (No Spoilers)
item.description: Six GTA 6 beginner tips: how saving works with no mission replay, why to bank your cash, feeding Dolores for Focus, what Focus does, the blue map buildings and the 4-weapon loadout.

item.title: GTA 6 Cheat Codes: Money, Armor, Ammo + How to Unlock
item.description: Verified GTA 6 cheat codes for PS5 and Xbox: the $250,000 money cheat, body armor, infinite ammo, no reload and more, how to unlock each one, and the catch (no saves, no trophies).

item.title: Best SSD for GTA 6 on PS5 (212 GB): What to Buy and What to Skip
item.description: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB. Which PS5 SSD works (Gen4 NVMe, heatsink, 5,500 MB/s), what size to get, the Xbox option, and how to install it. Black Friday 2026 tips.

item.title: GTA 6 Black Friday 2026: Live Deals on Controllers, Storage and the Game
item.description: GTA 6 Black Friday 2026 deals, checked November 20: the PS5 DualSense is $54 (was $74), the Pulse Elite headset is about $110, the GTA 6 Edition controller isn't discounted, GTA 6 itself isn't on sale in the US yet, and what to buy for the 212 GB install.

item.title: GTA 6 Launch Day Survival Guide: Servers, 30 FPS and Settings
item.description: GTA 6 is out. What to do if PSN or Xbox won't connect, the PS5 14.23 update, why every console runs at 30 FPS, what PS5 Pro changes, and the first settings to change. No spoilers.

item.title: Is PS5 Pro Worth It for GTA 6? Still 30 FPS: Our Verdict
item.description: Short answer: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console, PS5 Pro included. What the Pro does improve, and who should still buy one.

item.title: How Many GB Is GTA 6? 212 GB, and How to Make Room on PS5 and Xbox
item.description: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB. Free ways to clear space on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S first, then what to look for if you need a storage upgrade.

item.title: GTA 6 Reviews: 99 on Metacritic, Tied for the Best Score Ever
item.description: GTA 6 reviews are in: 99 on Metacritic and OpenCritic, tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest score ever, with no mixed or negative reviews. What critics loved and the one common complaint.

item.title: Best TV and Console Settings for GTA 6 (PS5 and Xbox)
item.description: Get GTA 6 looking and sounding right: TV Game Mode, HDR calibration, motion smoothing off, and console audio settings for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

item.title: GTA 6 Characters: Every One Confirmed (No Spoilers)
item.description: Jason, Lucia and the six supporting characters Rockstar has revealed for GTA 6, and who each one is. No story spoilers.
